operator_config.name: PipelineStateEnum_NOT_TRIGGERED
operator_config.doc:
Indicates that the task is not triggered based on the
[PipelineTaskSpec.TriggerPolicy.condition][] config.

operator_config.name: PipelineStateEnum_QUEUED
operator_config.doc:
Indicates that the task was just populated to the DB but not ready to
be scheduled.  Once job handler determined the task being ready to
be scheduled, the task state will change to PENDING.  The state
transition is depicted below:
 * QUEUED(not ready to run) --> PENDING(ready to run) --> RUNNING

operator_config.name: PipelineStateEnum_SKIPPED
operator_config.doc: Indicates that the task is skipped to run due to a cache hit.

operator_config.name: PipelineStateEnum_UNSCHEDULABLE
operator_config.doc:
Indicates that the tasks will no longer be schedulable.  Usually a task
was set to this state because its all upstream tasks are in final state
but the [PipelineTaskSpec.TriggerPolicy.strategy][] disallows the task to
be triggered.
The difference between `NOT_TRIGGERED` is that `UNSCHEDULABLE` must met
[PipelineTaskSpec.TriggerPolicy.strategy][], but must not met the
[PipelineTaskSpec.TriggerPolicy.condition][].

operator_config.name: PipelineTaskSpec_TriggerPolicy_ALL_UPSTREAM_TASKS_COMPLETED
operator_config.doc: Specifies that all upstream tasks are in any final state.

operator_config.name: PipelineTaskSpec_TriggerPolicy_ALL_UPSTREAM_TASKS_SUCCEEDED
operator_config.doc: Specifies that all upstream tasks are in succeeded state.

operator_config.name: PipelineTaskSpec_TriggerPolicy_TRIGGER_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED
operator_config.doc: Unspecified.  Behave the same as ALL_UPSTREAM_TASKS_SUCCEEDED.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_ENV
operator_config.doc:
Indicates that the environment variables should be passed through to the external workload.
It is generally safe to always set apply_to_task=true on this field.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_KUBERNETES_AFFINITY
operator_config.doc: Indicates that the Kubernetes node affinity should be passed through to the external workload.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_KUBERNETES_NODE_SELECTOR
operator_config.doc: Indicates that the Kubernetes node selector should be passed through to the external workload.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_KUBERNETES_TOLERATIONS
operator_config.doc: Indicates that the Kubernetes node tolerations should be passed through to the external workload.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_KUBERNETES_VOLUMES
operator_config.doc:
Indicates that the Kubernetes persistent volumes and ConfigMaps/Secrets mounted as volumes should be
passed through to the external workload. Be sure that when setting apply_to_task=true, the volumes are
ReadWriteMany or ReadOnlyMany or else the task's pod may not start.
This is useful when the task prepares a shared volume for the external workload or defines output artifact
(e.g. dsl.Model) that is created by the external workload.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_NONE
operator_config.doc: Throwaway default value.

operator_config.name: TaskConfigPassthroughType_RESOURCES
operator_config.doc:
Indicates that the resource limits and requests should be passed through to the external workload.
Be cautious about also setting apply_to_task=true since that will double the resources required for
the task.

	import (

	  clientsetscheme "k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/scheme"

correctly.

operator_config.name: retryIndexEnv
operator_config.doc:
retryIndexEnv injects the Argo retry attempt index into the executor
container. Argo substitutes {{retries}} with the 0-based attempt index at
pod creation time, so each retry attempt writes executor-logs to a distinct,
sequentially-numbered path (executor-logs-0, executor-logs-1, …).
This variable is only valid inside a template that has a retryStrategy, so
it must NOT be added to commonEnvs (which is applied to all templates).

a failed gRPC call before returning an error. This is intentionally higher

the MLMD server are transient and require time to resolve under sustained
parallel execution.
